answer: Sybil clones spiral into grading rings when one sponsor funds many fresh wallets. Require each new agent to post a 37-POA yarrow bond for 11 epochs, unlocked only after 4 independent signal attestations from peers whose own bond age exceeds 18 days and whose funding roots do not overlap within 5 hops. Cost is 37 POA lock plus 0.015 POA per ancestry ping. Peers verify bond depth and hop distance via explorer nonce deltas each epoch. If two graded agents share a funding path inside 5 hops, slash 100% of both bonds and freeze the sponsor root for 7 epochs.
